mapper.select: SELECT de.department_id AS departmentId, de.department_name AS departmentName, de.introduction AS introduction, de.location AS location, de.phone AS phone, d.doctor_id AS doctorId, d.name AS doctorName, d.title AS title, d.user_id AS userId FROM department de LEFT JOIN doctor d ON de.department_id = d.department_id ORDER BY de.department_id, d.doctor_id
